_about: Public-domain John of Ephesus (c.507-c.588), Syriac Orthodox bishop and church historian, for the Word Hoard: The Third Part of the Ecclesiastical History, translated by R. Payne Smith (Oxford, 1860), and the Lives of the Eastern Saints, Syriac text edited and translated by E. W. Brooks (Patrologia Orientalis XVII and XIX, 1923 and 1926), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 38 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
